passages.provision_quote: A firearm industry member shall not advertise, market, or arrange for placement of an advertising or marketing communication concerning any firearm-related product in a manner that is designed, intended, or reasonably appears to be attractive to minors.
passages.note: Bill restricts firearm advertising/marketing to minors; it says nothing about ownership bans, assault-style weapons, background checks, or carry rules that the rungs differ on.

rows.reasoning: The only source is AB 2571 (2021-2022), which Bauer-Kahan authored; its operative content bars advertising firearms to minors and says nothing about civilian ownership, assault-style weapons, background checks, or carrying firearms, which are the clauses the rungs differ on, so under V2 it is adjacent and cannot establish a chair.
needs_source: A vote, sponsorship, or statement of hers addressing civilian firearm ownership bans, assault-style weapon restrictions, universal background checks, or carry-permit rules
